dataset.title: Coral Triangle Field Record: a coral reef interaction web

abstract.para: An attested, illustrative interaction dataset for the Coral Triangle (maritime Southeast Asia: Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Papua New Guinea, Solomon Islands, Timor-Leste). Occurrences — nine species including the focal hawksbill sea turtle (Eretmochelys imbricata) and one human community (Homo sapiens) — are placed in the reef landscape and linked by resource relationships typed with OBO Relations Ontology terms. Taxonomy is the GBIF backbone; interactions are sourced from the cited literature. Coordinates are representative of the Coral Triangle geographic centre (Banda Sea, ~0.83°N 127.63°E). Ecological design produced under M9A Research Curator protocol (AI-OS v1.0); implemented under M9B Technical Lead protocol. Design specification: .agents/decisions/2026-06-27-coral-triangle-design-v2.md.
